items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Later on, I had a friend of mine from St. Louis, Cedric, he was telling me about this boat.

ctx.x: Who was Cedric? Which Cedric is that?

Gene Cedric, of St. Louis. A saxophone player who came down and knew all the boat with fate. One of his early bands. Sometimes I see him, I just gotta mention the river to him, his jaws start moving like crazy. Talking about, reminiscing about the river boats. He always speaks of the bald eagle with great respect. He would tell our great, big, fabulous river boats like the steamer capital, the jazz, these big fine, river excursion boats would be docked in town. They'd be playing and all of a sudden, the news…
Whose bands were you? Just pick up bands.
